dialogueLines.hi: Toofan me pothiyan bikhar gayi hain, Aru… Dharmaganja ka gyan samet lo!
dialogueLines.en: The storm scattered the manuscripts, Aru… gather the knowledge of Dharmaganja!

dialogueLines.hi: Nalanda me duniya bhar se vidyarthi aate the — Cheen se, Tibbat se!
dialogueLines.en: Students came to Nalanda from all over the world — from China, from Tibet!
